pages.text: The Speed Upgrade increases the processing speed of machines. In RS2, these upgrades have been enhanced with improved performance and better power efficiency. Each upgrade installed will reduce the time between operations while maintaining network stability.
Features:$(li)Enhanced processing speed boost$(li)Improved power efficiency in RS2$(li)Better stacking performance$(li)Works in all RS2 machines$(li)Optimized network impact

To use the Speed Upgrade:$(li)Right-click on a compatible machine$(li)Insert the upgrade into an upgrade slot$(li)Multiple upgrades can be installed$(li)Each upgrade will increase power consumption$(br2)RS2's improved upgrade system ensures better performance scaling.
